source.title: Updates from @WarcraftDevs Patch 7.3.5 & BFA Beta — archived developer reply 109
source.author: @WarcraftDevs (archived by Blue Tracker)

quote: Materials you receive from disenchanting are now based on the item’s expansion level, not its item level.
notes: Previously uncatalogued in v3 rate-changes.jsonl. 2018-01-26 original WarcraftDevs explanation is preserved verbatim in archived reply #109 (archive indexed 2018-01-29); Warcraft Wiki dates the underlying 7.3.5 patch to 2018-01-16. Developer explicitly gives Burning Crusade gear -> Burning Crusade materials, despite item level scaling. Historical source-supported processing rule only: does not verify any current Retail 12.x item 24995 Disenchant eligibility, output quantity, hit chance, operation count, or patch stability. Source dates and original URL are documented; do not infer an unmeasured contemporary client result. Master owns validation/central rate change and runtime treatment.
affects: Disenchant material expansion-family selection for scaled gear, explicitly including Burning Crusade-era equipment
wording: Materials received from disenchanting depend on item expansion rather than scaled item level.
